(1) (a) Where execution of any part of the Works requires excavation in a Street Maintained 
by the Highways Department the Contractor shall request the Employer to apply for 
an Excavation Permit from the Designated Authority. The Employer shall be the 
Permittee and the Contractor shall be nominated by the Employer as the Nominated 
Permittee of the Excavation Permit. The Contractor shall not withhold his consent to 
the nomination or agreement to comply with the conditions in the Excavation Permit

(b) Where execution of any part of the Works requires excavation in land o ther than a 
Street Maintained by the Highways Department and requires an Excavation Permit 
the Contractor shall apply to the Designated Authority for an Excavation Permit or 
for exemption under Section 10B of the Land (Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance

(Cap. 28) as the case may be for such part of the Works and, where an Excavation 
Permit has been applied for, shall be the Permittee.
